description: Khuphela imodeli ecetyiswayo ukuze uqalise ukuncokola, okanye ukhangele iHub ukuze ufumane enye.
quickStartFailed: Kukhona okungahambanga kakuhle. Nceda zama kwakhona.
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} yi-CPU-only yakha, ke i-{{gpus}} iya kuhlala ingasebenzi. Khetha i-GPU ngasemva kwiiSetingi ukuze uyisebenzise.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} idinga i-{{vendor}} GPU, kodwa i-Novera ifunyenwe {{gpus}}. I-Novera iya kusebenza kwi-CPU.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} ayikwazi ukufikelela kwi-GPU yakho, ngoko ke i-Novera iya kuqhuba kwi-CPU. Oku kuhlala kuthetha ukuba umqhubi we-GPU okanye ixesha lokubaleka lifuna uhlaziyo.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} ayikwazi ukuqalisa ngenxa yokuba ithala leencwadi elifunekayo alikho ({{libraries}}), ngoko ke i-Novera iya kuqhuba kwi-CPU.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Ayinakuqinisekisa ukuba injini inokusebenzisa i-GPU yakho
checkEngineUnavailable: Esi sakhiwo se-injini asikwazi ukuchaza isimo se-GPU
checkSearchNoVector: Imodeli yokufakela ayibuyisanga ziphumo, ke ukhangelo lwefayile aluzukusebenza okwangoku
checkSearchInvalidVector: Imodeli yokufakela ibuyise isiphumo esingasebenzisekiyo, ke uphendlo lwefayile alunakubuyisela nto.
checkSearchUnavailable: Esi sakhiwo se-injini asinakuqinisekisa imodeli yokufakela
welcomeBody: Oku kuthatha imizuzu embalwa: I-Novera ikhuphela injini yayo ye-inference kunye nemodeli encinci yokukhangela ifayile. Ungaqhubeka usebenzisa ikhompyuter yakho ngelixa isebenza.
setupDoneBody: Novera iya kuqhuba iimodeli zasekhaya kunye ne-llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Khuphela iqabane le-DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) le-LFM2.5-2.6B. Inokukhawulezisa isizukulwana, kodwa isebenzisa i-RAM eyongezelelweyo okanye i-VRAM, ishiya imemori encinci yomxholo. Yivavanye kwihardware yakho; Lungisa ubude bomxholo okanye uvale i-decoding eqikelelwayo kwisethingi yemodeli.
